description: This PHP class 'HTMLPurifier_Encoder' provides static methods for encoding and decoding UTF-8 strings, handling iconv conversions, cleaning UTF-8 strings for well-formedness and SGML validity, and testing iconv bugs and encoding support. It functions as a utility encoder for the HTMLPurifier library dedicated to UTF-8 specific character encoding tasks.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_Encoder
classes.description: A UTF-8 specific character encoder handling cleaning and transforming of strings, with static methods for encoding conversion, validation, and testing related to iconv bugs.

methods.name: muteErrorHandler
methods.description: A static method that mutes errors, used as an error handler during iconv operations.

methods.name: unsafeIconv
methods.description: Performs iconv conversion with error handling muted, converting text from one encoding to another.

methods.name: iconv
methods.description: Wraps iconv with workarounds for known bugs, splits large strings for compatible conversions, and handles error scenarios.

methods.name: cleanUTF8
methods.description: Cleans a UTF-8 string to ensure well-formedness and SGML validity, removing invalid or non-permitted codepoints.

methods.name: convertToUTF8
methods.description: Converts a string from a configured encoding to UTF-8, utilizing iconv or mb_convert_encoding, with exception handling for unsupported encodings.

methods.name: convertFromUTF8
methods.description: Converts a UTF-8 string to a configured encoding, optionally encoding non-ASCII characters as entities.

methods.name: convertToASCIIDumbLossless
methods.description: Transforms UTF-8 string into ASCII by replacing non-ASCII characters with numeric entities.

methods.name: iconvAvailable
methods.description: Checks whether iconv is available and not known to be unusable.

methods.name: testIconvTruncateBug
methods.description: Tests whether the iconv implementation has a bug causing output truncation when converting encodings.

methods.name: testEncodingSupportsASCII
methods.description: Tests whether a given encoding supports ASCII characters, returning mappings or false accordingly.

methods.name: unichr
methods.description: Returns a UTF-8 string representing the specified Unicode code point, or an empty string if invalid.
